exercise.name: Cable Skull Crusher
library_steps: Lie on a flat bench, head towards a low pulley, holding a short bar.
With arms straight up, bend your elbows to lower the bar to your forehead.
Straighten your arms again without moving your elbows.
exercise.one_line_summary: Lying on a flat bench with the head toward a low pulley, a short bar held overhand; upper arms point at the ceiling and stay still while the elbows bend from straight (~5 deg) to ~100 deg, lowering the bar to the forehead. Triceps does the work.

setup.target: Low, at about bench height, behind the head.
setup.why: Library step; cable keeps tension at the bottom.

setup.target: Pointing at the ceiling, a little toward the head.

muscles.emg: Cable elbow extensions with the arm overhead grew all three heads, the long head ~1.5x more than with the arm by the side (S1); all heads active in cable extensions (S2).
muscles.role: Straightens the elbow; what the exercise is for.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Elbows drift out or forward as the arms straighten.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Turns it into a press/pullover; the elbow should be the only joint moving (S1 protocol).
S1 trained the full 90-0 deg range.

sources.citation: Maeo S, Wu Y, Huang M, et al. 2023. Triceps brachii hypertrophy is substantially greater after elbow extension training performed in the overhead versus neutral arm position. Eur J Sport Sci 23(7):1240-1250.
sources.what_it_gave: Cable-machine elbow extensions (90-0 deg) with the arm overhead vs by the side (neutral, pushdown-like), 12 weeks: all three triceps heads grew in both; the long head grew ~1.5x more overhead.

sources.citation: Hussain J, Sundaraj K, Subramaniam ID, Lam CK. 2020. Muscle fatigue in the three heads of triceps brachii during intensity and speed variations of triceps push-down exercise. Front Physiol 11:112.
sources.what_it_gave: Cable triceps push-down to failure, sEMG of the long, lateral and medial heads: all three heads work and fatigue at comparable rates.

clip_check.check: Both fists closed on the bar; cable over the head to the pulley, clear of the head
